Task complete. Three milestones implemented in `boltons/iterutils.py`:

- **m1**: Added `cache=True` parameter to `remap()` — cache=True returns self-referential/cached results on cycles; cache=False raises RecursionError on cyclic structures via a visiting set for cycle detection.
- **m2**: Added `cache=True` parameter to `research()` and forwarded it to the internal `remap()` call.
- **m3**: Fixed `split(src, sep, maxsplit=0)` to return `list(src)` (consuming all values) instead of `[src]` (wrapping the source object), fixing iterator/range handling.

All 423 existing tests pass after each milestone commit. Only `boltons/iterutils.py` was modified.
